title: Security & Compliance review prep - 1:1 (SOC2/ISO)
content:
Meeting prep notes for 1:1 with Sarah (security reviewer) on SOC2/ISO controls, vendor risk, and audit readiness.

Quick goals:
- Get alignment on evidence backlog and priority for next SOC2 readiness sprint
- Agree owner list for missing controls (CC, RA, personnel, change mgmt)
- Discuss vendor risk gating and timeline for third-party questionnaires
- Confirm auditor scope and expected artifacts for next engagement

Agenda draft:
1) Quick status (2-3 min) -- what's changed since last sync
2) Evidence inventory review (10 min) -- missing items; who owns; blockers
3) Vendor risk (10 min) -- outstanding questionnaires, remediation letters, contracts
4) ISO scoping questions (5 min) -- scope boundaries for 27001, excluded assets
5) Next steps & owners (5 min)

Evidence checklist (current gaps):
- Access logs retention: need retention policy + ELK export (owner: Aaron) -- blocked by infra ticket (INF-998) -- target 2026-03-15
- Change management logs for model deployment: collect PR/approval artifacts (owner: Jordan) -- need to add template to GitHub PRs
- Vendor SOC2 letters: 3 vendors outstanding (vector-db, embeddings provider, monitoring) -- owner: Priya -- target 2026-03-22
- Encryption key management policy: draft exists but needs legal sign-off (owner: me) -- follow up legal (Jira LEG-204)

Vendor risk notes:
- New questionnaire from VectorDB: long form. Prioritize by data access (they host embeddings) -- ask product for list of datasets exposed
- For high-risk vendors, confirm contractual security clause & right-to-audit. Create redline checklist for legal
- Consider automated vendor scoping: map vendors by data sensitivity + access level

Audit readiness actions (short term):
- Build an 'evidence binder' folder in Drive: structure -> control family -> artifact links. (me) -- start skeleton by 2026-02-28
- Export last 6 months of access logs for critical infra (SRE) -- request to infra ops (Aaron) -- due 2026-03-05
- Compile training completion list for all engineers for 2025-2026 security training (HR) -- owner: Priya -- due 2026-03-10

Questions for Sarah:
- Are auditors okay with consolidated evidence for model inference (one combined artifact) or need per-deployment artifacts?
- For private deployments, do we need separate evidence per customer if isolation is at infra layer?
- Any preference for format (csv vs confluence page) for evidence ingestion?

Open items / notes to self:
- Follow up with infra on INF-998 and echo in #infra on Slack
- Draft vendor redline checklist and run by legal next week
- Put calendar hold for 30min deep-dive if Sarah requests evidence walkthrough

Immediate next steps (after 1:1):
- Send updated evidence inventory and assign owners (me) -- within 24h
- Create JIRA epic for SOC2 readiness sprint and add sub-tasks for each evidence gap
- Schedule vendor follow-ups with procurement & legal

Rough TO-DOs table:
- Aaron: export access logs (INF-998) -- 2026-03-05
- Jordan: collect deployment change PRs & approvals -- 2026-03-12
- Priya: vendor SOC2 letters & training list -- 2026-03-10
- Maya (me): evidence binder skeleton, legal follow-ups, create JIRA epic -- 2026-02-28

Notes: keep this as personal prep; will convert to formal ShareDrive doc after alignments. Rough phrasing ok. Bring up risk of embeddings vendor having broad data exposure (need scoping ask from product).
